description: Participant holds an expungement granted before an amendment and is returning to the granting court. Screening answers present; court, county, cause number, judge, prosecutor and prosecutor position, and every protected field, stay blank. The amendment relied on and the relief sought stay empty: the amendment is counsel-settled per cycle and the relief is participant-authored.

screeningAnswers.originalExpungementCourt: [PARTICIPANT ANSWER - SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE: the Indiana court that granted the original expungement, plus the date of the order]
screeningAnswers.originalExpungementSection: [PARTICIPANT ANSWER - SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE: the section the original expungement was granted under]
screeningAnswers.amendmentRelieadOn: [COUNSEL-SETTLED FOR THE CYCLE - NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE AND NOT SETTLED AT THE TIME OF THIS FIXTURE]
screeningAnswers.reliefSought: [PARTICIPANT-AUTHORED - NOT SUPPLIED, EXPANDED OR ARGUED BY LEGALEASE]

eligibilityData.grantedBeforeAmendment: [PARTICIPANT ANSWER - SYNTHETIC TEST VALUE: participant states the original order predates the amendment]
eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted. Whether the petitioner was granted relief before the amendment and is otherwise entitled to the relief the amendment provides is the court's finding.

attachments: Certified copy of the original expungement order (participant obtains from the clerk of the granting court; LegalEase does not inspect it)
expectedBehaviour: Renders as a container. The statement-of-relief and proposed-order slots stay empty because the cycle's amendment is not settled; the packet is not releasable in this state, which is the point of the amendment gate.
